title: Centered log resolution induced by a fixed rational rule
statement: Fix a regular-functorial normalized resolution rule $\mathcal F$ [def-per-regular-normalized-resolution-rule]. Its rational inputs are those of [def-per-qe-ordinary-resolution-rule]. An induced resolution datum consists of a smooth-functorial monoscheme rule $R_m$ and fan rule $R_f$ [def-per-monoscheme-resolution-sharpening-data], [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. For every monoscheme input $M$, the rational toric realization of every stage of $R_m(M)$ is identified with $\mathcal F(\mathbf Q[M])$ over the prescribed base, with bijective ordered stage and level indices. The arrows are the canonical realization maps and the ring centers are exactly the monomial-generated ideals [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization]. The existing rule-sharpening comparison identifies $R_f$ with the sharpening of $R_m$, including its smooth pullback comparisons. No fan center is the whole monoid sheaf. There is a strict etale log blowup procedure $L$ on all Noetherian fs log regular schemes, without separation or excellence assumptions [def-trf-strict-etale-log-blowup-procedure], [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Every such input has torsion-free geometric characteristic groups. For every global fan chart, its prescribed lifted fan resolution [lem-trf-log-fan-chart-blowup] contracts to $L$ over the actual log identity, retaining ordered centers and maps. No global log center is the whole log structure. Each underlying scheme tower keeps the same levels and arrows and is a normalized resolution; its ring center is the ideal $\alpha(I)\mathcal O$ generated by its log center, characterized by equality after every geometric strict-local ring map. Its zero locus is nonempty and nowhere dense. These underlying resolutions use the existing normalized tower construction. Equality of two of them over a base isomorphism means equality of their lengths and a synchronized center-preserving levelwise scheme isomorphism [def-per-normalized-tower-descent-data] with the specified base map; no contraction is allowed in this equality. A lifted fan tower is converted to a log tower simply by keeping its levels, arrows and chart-pulled centers.
